description: This file declares the interface for the OcdmSystem class and its factory, which are responsible for managing OpenCDM system interactions within the Rialto server component. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies related to DRM system management.

classes.name: OcdmSystemFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of OcdmSystem, implementing the IOcdmSystemFactory interface.

classes.name: OcdmSystem
classes.description: Implementation of the IOcdmSystem interface, managing DRM system interactions.

methods.name: createOcdmSystem
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IOcdmSystem instance based on the provided key system string.

methods.name: OcdmSystem
methods.description: Constructor initializing the OcdmSystem with a specific key system.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version information of the DRM system.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit for LDL (License Delivery Limit) sessions.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getSecureStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the secure store.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Gets the current DRM system time.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with the specified client.
